name: OpenAI Realtime
summary: OpenAI's Realtime API runs speech-to-speech models over WebRTC or WebSocket, so a voice agent can listen, reason, call tools and answer in one session. The current models are gpt-realtime-2 and gpt-realtime-2.1 (plus a mini variant), with configurable reasoning effort. OpenAI also offers a separate GPT-Live endpoint for full-duplex voice that delegates reasoning to a backend model.
goodFor: Tool calls during a live conversation
watchOut: Audio tokens cost far more than text tokens
The Realtime API beta was removed on 2026-05-12, so old beta clients must migrate
